product.name: Aurelio SmartSense 360° Air Quality Monitor
product.description: The Aurelio SmartSense 360° Air Quality Monitor offers continuous monitoring of indoor air conditions, measuring particulate matter, CO2, temperature, and humidity. Its compact design fits on any countertop or wall mount, while the sleek slate‑gray casing blends with modern décor. The device connects via Wi‑Fi and Bluetooth to a companion app, providing real‑time alerts and historical trends. A low‑power 5‑W operation ensures efficient battery life when powered by a standard 5‑V USB adapter. Built with durable ABS plastic and silicone seals, the monitor resists dust and moisture for reliable performance in kitchens, offices, and living spaces.
